column1: 5.5.4.2.20.6 BITE – Show EA Manual BITE Status. User shall click on this menu item
to view the status of manual BITE on EA system. A GUI, as shown in Figure-5.199, shall
be displayed with BITE status. The BITE status, along with start & stop time stamps, shall
be updated on this GUI as on when received from EA Processor. User can perform manual
BITE test on EA system again by clicking on ‘Test Again’ option.
